svg.title: Recording options and the recording block
svg.text: Also record sound from this PC
Tell everyone before you record a meeting.

g.text: Title bar drag area: keep 200+ px empty
Record and Options sit side by side
Nothing records until Record is pressed
While recording, a recording block takes the audio’s place in the page
What you write while recording is time-stamped; Alt+click a word to hear it
The title bar shows Recording and the time; select it for the controls

svg.text: Keep-out zone: nothing interactive or important goes here
